0-5.$description: 2px (0.5 × 4): a value and its unit, a label and its value in a Stat.

1.$description: 4px (1 × 4): lines in a group (a title and its detail); a list's padding above and below.

1-5.$description: 6px (1.5 × 4): items in a row (an icon and its label, a dot and its word).

2.$description: 8px (2 × 4): an icon and a row's text; controls side by side; the default Stack gap.

3.$description: 12px (3 × 4): between groups of a toolbar or status line.

4.$description: 16px (4 × 4): between sections of a list or inspector; between columns of a table (2 × 8).

6.$description: 24px (6 × 4): between a dashboard's panes; above a document's column.

8.$description: 32px (8 × 4): below a document's column. Rarely anything else.

10.$description: 40px (10 × 4): Room for a page that is read, rarely.

space.$description: The spacing scale: multiples of a 4px unit, named by the multiple (--space-2 is 8px; --space-1-5 is 6px). Components read roles (inset, row-pad…) where one exists; docs/46-spacing.md.

bar-inset.$description: A bar's inset, tighter than the content's: a window's title bar, a view's footer, Magic's toolbars (a title band's heading is content, on the inset).

page-inset.$description: A page's inset (Page, settings beside their sidebar): twice the window's, for a page that is read more than scanned. Its View takes it as --inset.

inset.$description: A window's content inset, on every side, measured to the letters: a padded body, the first and last table column, list rows' content, footer text. One value for every window.

measure.$description: Reading width for prose: a document's column (Measure).

w.$description: How wide a page of settings rows grows (the Settings window): rows keep their label and control within reach in a wide window; the page centres past it.
